Israeli strike kills Gaza World Cup screening organizer

An Israeli strike in Gaza has killed Mohammed al-Wahidi, an organizer of public screenings for World Cup matches. The incident occurred shortly before a screening was set to begin, where many football fans had gathered. Health authorities in Gaza reported the death, which comes amidst ongoing conflict in the region.
